name: Diamond Ember
description: Diamond-dot rows in a mixed ink palette, sized as a seamless repeating tile.

code.style: --rule: ( background: @doodle( :doodle { @grid: 1 / 3000px; transform: rotate(45deg) scale(2); } background-size: 30px 30px; background-image: @doodle( @grid: 5x1 / calc(100% + 1px); @place-cell: center; @size: calc(100% - 100% / @size * (@i - 1)); border-radius: calc(100% / @size * (@i - 1)); border: 1px solid var(--color1); background: @pn( var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5) ); ); ); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
